subject.title: Draft: add commands list and inspect inventory

question: After the concrete blockers are fixed, should OpenClaw converge this operator inventory with Gateway `commands.list`, or own a separate `openclaw commands` schema and expanded plugin descriptor contract?
rationale: The PR explicitly requests public-surface selection, current main already has a distinct command inventory API, the linked RFC remains open, and the protected `maintainer` label requires human direction.

options.title: Converge with Gateway
options.body: Use one canonical command inventory model and project it into CLI-friendly JSON or Markdown as needed.

options.title: Approve separate contracts
options.body: Own distinct source sets, schemas, consumers, lifecycle, and convergence rules for CLI and Gateway inventories.

options.title: Pause for RFC
options.body: Keep the draft unmerged until the RFC selects the permanent contract boundary.

recommendation.title: Converge with Gateway
recommendation.body: Use one canonical command inventory model and project it into CLI-friendly JSON or Markdown as needed.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest sampled history across the affected public CLI, plugin, and Gateway surfaces and is explicitly mentioned in the PR timeline.
